statement: This verdict OVERWRITES the Board 10 bar of the same name, kept byte for byte as bench/verdicts/autopilot-board10.json (written 2026-09-24T02:37:18.815Z, 21 of 21 checks, MET); the 21 checks of Boards 8 and 10 run here first, unchanged. In a copied tree holding the real gate program (bench/gate.mjs 466ae297826f) a planted fix was KEPT with the gate going from exit 1 to exit 1, a planted patch that turned test/area.test.mjs red was REVERTED byte for byte on a CRLF file, and a patch aimed at a test file was refused at the ceiling. On the real tree, brain self-code --auto --dry --json read 109 candidates by source (gate 0, notes 80, imagine 1, census 23, slow 5, mutants 0), would apply 0, and wrote nothing. One wet CLI pass on a planted repository copy with the model author off kept 0 candidates from non-mutant sources () with the gate GREEN and appended 1 line to state/self/authored.jsonl with the gate hash before and after. The model cell qwen3:30b-a3b through Ollama was asked 1 time for a planted OPEN: line, answered in 36221 ms, and its patch was KEPT with the gate RED-NO-REGRESSION. Over the wet copy and the real docs/BOARDS.json the share is 1/281. Board 14: on a planted tree state/self/STOP refused the soak with exit 0 and nothing written; one soak of 0.5 minutes took the planted gap from the gaps source through knob-tune on a copy and kept it (before 64, after 96, noise 1.55) with the gate GREEN, appended the authorship line "organism (knob-tune)", rebuilt the ledger and printed the gap CLOSED, with 0 copies left on disk; the orchestrator rate read 11 boards landed and 12 bars met (a floor: 9 landed lines name no count) over 8.5139 days. 21 of 26 checks passed.
